title: Property Franchise Group invests £900,000 in AI platform
summary:
The Property Franchise Group has acquired a 25% stake in conversational AI platform Enteka Ai for £900,000. The platform is currently operational across more than 210 TPFG offices and handles enquiries across multiple channels including telephone, email, SMS, WhatsApp and live chat.

title: 44% of UK homeowners research property moves in secret
summary:
Nearly half of British homeowners have taken property-related actions without informing other adults in their household, according to research published by Zoopla. The property portal's study found that 44% of homeowners have secretly browsed homes for sale or checked their current property's value.

title: Spanish housing measures raise questions for UK rental market
summary:
Spain's housing crisis and government response could offer insights into potential UK rental market regulation. The Spanish government has proposed measures including holiday let regulation and eviction bans, though political opposition has triggered a snap election.

title: Romans appoints sales director after 25-year tenure
summary:
Romans, part of the LRG group, has appointed Jonathan Hawthorne as Sales Director following a 25-year career progression within the Thames Valley-based estate agency. The appointment comes as estate agents navigate extended transaction times and shifting market conditions.

title: One third of tax software unable to file full returns
summary:
Analysis of HMRC's official software list reveals that one in three products approved for Making Tax Digital cannot yet file complete tax returns for landlords. Of 128 approved products, 44 either have tax return functionality in development or do not include it.

title: Propertymark issues guide on tenant pet requests
summary:
Propertymark has published a guide for letting agents on managing tenant pet requests, addressing evolving regulations across the UK. The resource covers frameworks including the Renters' Rights Act 2025 in England and the Housing (Scotland) Act 2025.

title: Estate agents adapt services as transaction times extend
summary:
Estate agents are diversifying services, implementing AI tools and streamlining operations in response to extended transaction times and changing consumer expectations. Research from The Guild of Property Professionals shows deals are taking up to 20 weeks to complete in some cases.

title: Lender provides £3.25m loan for City Road hostel refinance
summary:
Specialist lender MERA has provided a £3.25 million stabilisation loan to refinance a 131-bed hostel on City Road, London. The 24-month bridging facility allows the borrower to establish a trading history before securing longer-term financing.

title: Maslow Capital provides £136.8m refinance for Manchester towers
summary:
Maslow Capital has completed a £136.8 million refinance for two residential towers at Circle Square in Manchester, secured against the North and East Towers on the Oxford Road corridor. The facility enables Vita Group to repay existing debt and acquire its joint venture partner's interest in both buildings.
